day_selection: Full 24-hour bins anchored at each evaluation segment start; eligible for all hour-12 gaps; five bins spread chronologically per period, selected without using errors.
gap_selection: First observation at or after relative hours 6, 12 and 18; hidden intervals centred around its index.
checks: All gaps/context within the selected day; adjacent intervals no greater than 30 minutes; hidden indices excluded from spline context; finite predictions; metrics independently recalculated from point predictions with absolute tolerance 1e-9.
limitations: Relative hours are not local clock times. Gaps are separate simulations and may overlap. Previously examined periods are not an untouched test set. Selected cases do not establish universal method-selection rules.
